profile.summary: Sysco San Francisco is the Bay Area operating company of Sysco, a large food distributor. It supplies food and related products to restaurants, schools and other institutions from a distribution center in Fremont, California.

review.notes: Sysco's San Francisco location page (fetched directly) shows 5900 Stewart Avenue, Fremont, CA 94538, (510) 226-3000, and says it distributes to customers including restaurants and educational facilities; the SAM-sourced directory page confirms the legal name SYSCO SAN FRANCISCO, INC. at the same address. This is the Fremont Sysco operating company, which fits OUSD's pre-prepared meals contract, and the summary is neutral and supported.
